content.text: No non-compete or field-of-use restriction binds the Client anywhere in this agreement; the only "Non-Competition" reference constrains TrueLink's use of Credit Data.

input.quote: Notwithstanding the foregoing, Client is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other hardware, software system, design, formula, procedure or trade secret to provide software and services similar to the ones provided by TrueLink hereunder, so long as such
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete, exclusivity, field-of-use or territory restriction on Client. Section 2(a) expressly confirms the opposite of a restriction: Client is free to acquire, develop, license or use competing software and services (subject only to non-infringement of TrueLink IP and the Section 10 confidentiality obligations, per p0024), which meets and exceeds the preferred position. The Client covenants in Section 8 are limited to legal compliance, non-misrepresentation of underwriting decisions, access control, content warranties and anti-spam — none restricts the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. The only "compete" reference (p0054, incorporating a separate Non-Competition Agreement) operates as a limitation on TrueLink's licence to use Credit Data, i.e. it binds the counterparty and benefits us, so it is not flagged; we note only that that separate agreement is not attached and should be diligenced to confirm it contains no reciprocal restriction on Client.
